title: A language-search control did not pass its frozen rule
question: Did four archived non-English language controls satisfy the source’s preregistered power test?
reader_question: Did this language search validate its non-English scorers?
summary: The source reports 20,480 decodes, but its four language controls all tie the English scorer on the frozen detection-rate test. The program substituted a different comparison to proceed.
finding: All four own-language models and the English scorer cleared their respective wrong-key maxima on all 24 plants per language. None satisfies the frozen requirement that the own-language model have strictly greater detection power. The program instead compared d-prime scores and marked all four validated. Its reported zero manuscript survivors is not a control-validated exclusion under the original rule.
limitations: This independently audits the pinned plan, source decision logic and saved summary rows; it does not rerun the 24-plant simulations, their 60 wrong-key decodes per language, or the reported 20,480 manuscript decodes. The outcome does not say whether any proposed language is the plaintext.
next_steps: Freeze a control with measurable power to distinguish the languages, then rerun the same complete search and its matched null using one unchanged decision rule.

scope.representation: Pinned Dukotah R24-C1-ext plan, Python decision code, and the saved 24-plant/60-wrong-key summary for four non-English registers. No manuscript run was performed locally.
scope.procedure: Verify Git-object hashes; independently evaluate the strict power inequality in the plan and the d-prime inequality in the program on each saved register row; compare the validated-register lists.
scope.parameters: Latin, Greek, Old English and Enochian; source control length 120 runes, 24 plants and 60 wrong-key controls per language. A source-reported 20,480-case LP2 grid is contextual, not locally rerun.
scope.exclusions: No conclusion about actual plaintext language, the entire key family, the source’s numeric manuscript scores, other source registers, or a control with different difficulty or thresholds.

review.reviewer: Independent saved-row and source-rule checker; original simulation and manuscript grid not rerun

reproduction.environment: Python 3 standard library; source files and saved receipts from pinned Git revision are bundled.

visuals.caption: For each non-English register, both scorers found all 24 plants; the preregistered rule required the own-language model to outperform English.

sources.label: Pinned R24-C1-ext control program and saved results
